_doc: Repeatable turn-ins for the Argent Dawn (Scourgestones) and the Order of the Pale Flame (Crusader's Insignia). Written by tools/build_plaguelands_rewards.py.

quests.title: Minion's Scourgestones
quests.description: Bring Archmage Hale a handful of Minion's Scourgestones from the lesser dead of the western Plaguelands.
quests.accept_text:
The lesser dead carry Minion's Scourgestones, little slivers of the necromancy that keeps them walking. The ghouls and skeletons in the west have most of them.

I break them down here, on holy ground, where it's safe to. The Dawn remembers who brings them, and so do I.

Bring me a handful whenever you have them. I'll take them as often as you've got them.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's a handful. The Dawn's grateful, and so am I.

Bring me more when you've got them.

quests.title: Invader's Scourgestones
quests.description: Bring Archmage Hale a handful of Invader's Scourgestones from the Scourge in the eastern Plaguelands.
quests.accept_text:
The Scourge that march in the east carry heavier shards. Invader's Scourgestones, we call them, and they're cold enough to hurt. The dead round Stratholme and Terrordale carry most of them.

The Dawn pays twice over for these. Every one is a little less of whatever moves the Scourge.

Bring me a handful whenever you can. Wear gloves, because they bite.
quests.turn_in_text:
These are heavy ones. Every shard here is one less thing walking toward the wall.

Come back when you've got more.

quests.title: A Corruptor's Scourgestone
quests.description: Bring Archmage Hale a Corruptor's Scourgestone from one of the Scourge's named horrors.
quests.accept_text:
The Scourge's named horrors carry Corruptor's Scourgestones, a fist of crystal that feels like it's watching you. I want every one of them destroyed, and the Dawn pays well for each.

If you've killed one of the Scourge's named horrors and you've got its stone, bring it to me and nobody else. Don't keep it in your pack overnight.
quests.turn_in_text:
I'll see it broken tonight. That one was watching you, I promise.

The Dawn won't forget it, and neither will the newcomers who hold the wall beside us.

quests.title: Crusader's Insignia
quests.description: Bring Chaplain Odile Marchand a handful of Crusader's Insignia from the Scarlets of the Plaguelands.
quests.accept_text:
Every Scarlet in the Plaguelands carries a Crusader's Insignia, a red flame on a white field. I keep count of the ones that come back to the Order, because every badge is one fewer fanatic burning somebody's farm.

Bring me a handful whenever you have them. I'll write each one down, and then I'll melt them. The Order pays its thanks for every handful.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's a handful of fanatics who won't be lighting anything tonight.

I used to mark exams, back home. I never thought I'd be counting badges instead. Bring me more when you've got them.
